name: Working Directory
thesis: A personal filesystem where the things Raygen makes are the interface, with a real image viewer beside plainspoken project notes.
interaction: Choose projects from the directory, inspect their actual artwork, and toggle SERV0 between its enclosed render and open assembly.
why: Acid-yellow directory lettering, a deep green work surface, and source-file structure make an authored home for a hardware builder without imitating an IDE or a hacking terminal.
